page.notes: The running text is one printed paragraph continuing from the previous page, so it carries cont="true". The catchword reads "qve" in the scan and is transcribed as "que[?]" because the final letter is uncertain. Long s is normalised to s and u/v to the vowel/consonant spelling, as the rules require. Greek "πάρεργα" is kept as printed. "Hebraeo - Samaritanum" is copied with the spaces printed.
